EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement is made in Mumbai, Maharashtra on January 1, 2024 between ABC Technologies Pvt Ltd (Employer) and John Doe (Employee).

1. POSITION: Employee is hired as Senior Software Engineer.

2. SALARY: Rs 15,00,000 per annum, payable monthly.

3. TERMINATION: Either party may terminate with 30 days notice. Employer may terminate immediately for cause without notice or compensation.

4. NON-COMPETE: Employee shall not work for any competitor within India for 3 years after termination.

5. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY: All work created during employment belongs exclusively to Employer, including work done outside office hours.

6. ARBITRATION: Any disputes shall be resolved by arbitration in Mumbai. The arbitrator shall be appointed solely by the Employer.

7. DATA HANDLING: Employee agrees to process customer personal data as directed by Employer without any restrictions.

8. GRATUITY: Gratuity shall be paid only at the sole discretion of the Employer.

9. PROVIDENT FUND: Company may deduct PF but deposit timing is at company's discretion.

10. BONUS: No bonus shall be payable regardless of company profits.
